_comment: DexPilot teleop tunables. Loaded by teleop.dexpilot_arm_controller.load_teleop_config() and fed to DexPilotController. position.mode is overridden by the --position-mode CLI flag when given.

position._comment_mode: relative = press-8 re-zeroable, abs_scale x (board displacement from press-8). absolute = true absolute, board origin -> robot base (0,0,0), whole position x abs_scale. Overridden by --position-mode.
position._comment_abs_scale: Uniform position gain (applies to BOTH relative and absolute). 1.0 = 1:1 metres. >1 amplifies reach.
position._comment_world_from_board: 3x3 rotation remapping board axes -> robot world axes (applied to the position/displacement only). Identity = board==robot world; flip/swap columns to invert or swap axes. Set to SWAP x<->y so the operator-table LENGTH maps to the robot-table LENGTH (operator & robot tables had x-y inverted): board-x -> robot-y, board-y -> robot-x.
